title: Northgate Credit Cards Rewards Definitions: Reward Year, Cap Count, Rounding and Reversal Rate
content:
These defined terms apply to the rewards of Northgate Credit Cards. Each term has the same meaning on all six card products, as the table at the end shows.

## Defined terms

**Reward year.** The reward year is made up of the January through December statements: every statement whose statement month falls in January to December of one calendar year belongs to that year's reward year.

**What the gas and EV charging cap counts.** The cap counts qualifying gas and EV charging spend in the reward year — an amount of spend, not of reward.

**Rounding of earned rewards.** Earned rewards are rounded per statement and per earning category, to the cent: each category on each statement yields one reward amount, rounded to the cent.

**Reversal on returns.** Returns and purchase credits reverse rewards.

**Reversal rate.** A reversal is computed at the rate earned by the original purchase.

## Per card product

| Card product | Reward year | Gas and EV charging cap counts | Earned rewards rounded | Returns and purchase credits reverse rewards | Rate a reversal is computed at |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Store Card | January through December statements | Qualifying spend in the reward year | Per statement, per category, to the cent | Yes | Rate earned by the original purchase |
| Northgate Business Store Card | January through December statements | Qualifying spend in the reward year | Per statement, per category, to the cent | Yes | Rate earned by the original purchase |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature | January through December statements | Qualifying spend in the reward year | Per statement, per category, to the cent | Yes | Rate earned by the original purchase |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business | January through December statements | Qualifying spend in the reward year | Per statement, per category, to the cent | Yes | Rate earned by the original purchase |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Signature Plus | January through December statements | Qualifying spend in the reward year | Per statement, per category, to the cent | Yes | Rate earned by the original purchase |
| Northgate Rewards Visa Business Plus | January through December statements | Qualifying spend in the reward year | Per statement, per category, to the cent | Yes | Rate earned by the original purchase |

## Illustrations (hypothetical figures)

- **Reward year.** A statement whose statement month is December belongs to that calendar year's reward year; the statement whose statement month is the following January opens the next reward year.
- **Rounding.** On one statement, hypothetical restaurant spend of $41.37 at a hypothetical 3% gives $1.2411, which is rounded to $1.24; hypothetical travel spend on the same statement is rounded separately as its own category amount. The two categories are never added before rounding.
- **Reversal rate.** A purchase that earned a hypothetical 2% and is later returned is reversed at that same 2%, whatever rate the category would earn on the statement the return posts on.
